metadata.sigma_plain_english: Sigma is how far the other nine teams stray from consensus, measured in draft picks: 5 is a disciplined room, 10 is about one round of slippage (the default), 20 is chaotic. It is a guess, not fitted to observed drafts, which is why every number is given at all three settings.
metadata.reliability_note: These probabilities never pass through the projection curve, so they are the most reliable numbers in the project. They describe draft behaviour, not football outcomes.
